modalkeys.docKinds.description: Select commands move the cursor and/or selections.
modalkeys.docKinds.name: motion

modalkeys.docKinds.description: Operators are actions that take motions as suffix arguments (e.g. to delete (`d`) a word (`w`) you would type `dw`). If you wish to perform the operator action over a single line, you hit the operator key twice. In visual mode, an operator performs it's action over the selected text.
modalkeys.docKinds.name: operator

modalkeys.docKinds.description: Actions do something (usually to the text of a document).
modalkeys.docKinds.name: action

modalkeys.docKinds.description: History commands modify or use the history of executed commands, in some way.
modalkeys.docKinds.name: history

modalkeys.docKinds.description: Mode commands change the key mode, possibly completely changing what all of the keys do.
modalkeys.docKinds.name: mode

modalkeys.docKinds.description: Counts serve as prefix arguments to other commands, and usually determine how many times to repeat the commnad, unless otherwise specified.
modalkeys.docKinds.name: count

modalkeys.docKinds.description: Window commands manipulate the window in some way.
modalkeys.docKinds.name: window

modalkeys.docKinds.description: Leaders serve as prefixes to an entire list of key commands
modalkeys.docKinds.name: leader
